title: Three PyPI MCP servers opened a reverse shell before serving a single tool
summary: Three packages published to PyPI presented themselves as FastMCP-based servers offering a run_command tool, and their main function executed a Python reverse shell to 45.115.38.27 on port 4433 before starting the MCP server. JFrog reported them on 19 October 2025 and all three are gone from PyPI.
severity_rationale: Interactive shell on the developer host at MCP server startup, before any agent interaction takes place.
